_comment: Example Visual DNA extraction for the Fracture source image (chrome shattered geometric forms, mid-explosion, dark void with magenta/cyan accents, 2:3 portrait). This is the high-quality baseline a strong extraction should produce. Refer to this when uncertain about specificity or field-fill depth during your own extractions. The leading underscore on '_comment' marks this as a non-schema annotation that downstream code should ignore.

meta.overall_intent: Hypermodern abstract product/cover artwork conveying controlled chaos and luxury via mirror-polished chrome geometry caught mid-fragmentation against a dark studio void with electric-accent rim lighting.

subject.primary: cluster of shattered chrome geometric forms mid-explosion
secondary: individual angular chrome fragments suspended in arc
central dissolving silhouette implied by the fragment cloud
subject.pose_or_action: fragments captured at the apex of outward-radiating explosion, each piece in motion-frozen suspension
subject.wardrobe_or_surface: mirror-polished chrome with sharp specular highlights and faint magenta/cyan environmental reflections on the fragment faces

materials.texture_notes: mirror-finish with crisp specular highlights, faint colored environment reflections on the fragment faces

style.art_movement: hypermodern luxury product / concept art crossover

post_processing.color_grade_notes: deep crushed blacks, subtle halation around the brightest magenta specular hits, clean uncompressed digital aesthetic

notes: complex specular reflections requiring strong material rendering
fragment count and distribution affects visual density and is hard to reproduce exactly
